newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia's Goh Ban suspension extended.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia's Goh Ban suspension extended.

text.p: Malaysia's Goh Ban Huat Bhd has been granted an additional three market days of stock suspension from Tuesday to announce details of proposed transactions, the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange said on Tuesday.

In a statement, the exchange said the application of extension until October 18 was approved "on the grounds that the parties involved require additional time to finalise legal documents" regarding the transactions.
The exchange did not disclose the nature of the transactions. Shares of the company, which makes ceramic ware, pipes and other products, last traded at 7.75 ringgit on September 19.
